name: collide
description: Several coding agents on one repo, without the collisions: each agent is briefed on the code its prompt is about, told the moment another agent or teammate changes what it depends on, and has its pushes rebased, tested and landed in one step.

interface.longDescription: Collide keeps coding agents that work on the same repository, on one machine or across a team, from overwriting each other. Each agent is briefed on the code its task is about, hears when another agent changes code it depends on, and is held from writing over work in progress. Collide's MCP server adds tools to look up any symbol, see what depends on it, and leave notes on code for the next agent.
defaultPrompt: Is anyone else working on this code right now?
What depends on this function before I change it?
Brief me on the code this task touches
